discription: Slowly pulsating pad sound using a sine wave with an LFO on amplitude. It features a long ADSR envelope for sustained texture and an LFO on amplitude to create a gentle, repetitive swell.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, atk=0.5, dec=1.0, sus=0.7, rel=2.0, lfoRate=0.5;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(atk, dec, sus, rel, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);var lfo = (SinOsc.kr(lfoRate) * 0.4) + 0.6;sig = SinOsc.ar(freq) * amp * env * lfo;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
